attempts.name: ecell-transparent
attempts.prompt:

Asset type: transparent PNG logo cutout for a website.
Input image: the supplied E-CELL image is the edit target.
Edit only the flat neutral light grey backdrop. Remove it fully, including backdrop visible in all negative-space holes within and between the wooden logo elements, arrow shafts, balloon ropes and lettering contours. Return genuine transparent RGBA alpha, never a painted checkerboard, white/grey rectangle, or white/grey circle.
Preserve the exact full existing E-CELL logo composition, exact text "E-CELL", original letterforms and white/cream lettering fill with dark burgundy outline. Preserve all carved timber shapes and wood grain, red arrow feathers and shafts, goblin portrait with glasses and its frame, balloon and suspended basket and ropes, gold coins, skull rocket, orange flame, black curved flourish, their colours, relative size, placement, contours and soft object shading. Preserve white and grey details belonging to actual logo objects; only the empty neutral backdrop becomes transparent. Do not erase interior object surfaces or the letter fills.
Keep the complete logo visible with modest transparent padding at a useful large resolution. No redesign, no altered letters, no added objects, no new text, no added background, no branding additions. Preserve image content faithfully; change only the background to transparency.

attempts.name: ecell-transparent-v2
attempts.prompt:
BACKGROUND EXTRACTION EDIT — TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND OUTPUT.
Use the supplied original E-CELL logo as the edit target. The required deliverable is an RGBA PNG cutout with a real alpha channel: every empty background pixel outside the logo and in all internal negative-space gaps must have alpha 0. Transparency must be encoded in the PNG pixels, never illustrated as a visible pattern or rendered backdrop.
Change only the flat light grey background to actual transparency. Carefully remove grey background in the wooden emblem's interior gaps, between arrow shafts and balloon ropes, and everywhere the backdrop is visible. Preserve all solid artwork surfaces. Preserve the exact original logo content and composition: wooden geometric emblem, light and red timber textures, dark red outlines, red-feathered arrows, green goblin portrait in its wooden ring, gold coins, black curved flourish, balloon and basket with skull and ropes, skull rocket with orange flame, and the exact "E-CELL" lettering and letterforms with light fill and burgundy outline. Retain all contour detail and soft shading that belongs to the objects. White/grey colouring on real objects is not background and must be retained.
Use the original supplied logo, without redesign or retouching its shapes, colours, placement, texture, text, size relationships, or details. Keep the full logo within the frame with modest transparent padding. This is solely a background-removal operation.
OUTPUT REQUIREMENT: actual transparent RGBA PNG, alpha 0 for empty space. No visible backdrop of any kind. No painted transparency grid. No white or grey rectangle or circle. No new text or new objects.
